era: Sega Saturn / Game Gear / Xbox / modern remake
summary: Sega's dragon-riding rail-shooter and RPG series, from Team Andromeda's Saturn trilogy through Orta and the 2020 remake.

entries.title: Panzer Dragoon
entries.definitive_edition: Original game via Panzer Dragoon Orta bonus

emulation.emulator: Xbox backward compatibility / Mednafen Saturn / Kronos
emulation.notes: Use Orta's bonus game on supported Xbox hardware for the official route; Saturn emulation is the purist fallback.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Backward-compatible Xbox output or high-resolution Saturn emulation

primary.version: Original game included as a Panzer Dragoon Orta bonus
primary.why: The 1995 original shipped on Saturn and later received Windows, PS2, R-Zone/LCD, and Orta-bonus routes. Panzer Dragoon Orta includes the entire playable original, and Orta is backward compatible on later Xbox hardware, making the Xbox route the strongest modern official path to the classic game rather than the separate remake.
primary.how_to_play: Play Panzer Dragoon Orta on original Xbox, backward-compatible Xbox 360/Xbox One hardware, or compatible Xbox emulation, then launch the original Panzer Dragoon bonus feature.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Saturn release and artistic baseline.
all_releases.reason: skip: purist route, but the Orta bonus/backward-compatible Xbox route is a stronger modern official access path.
skip: heavily simplified LCD/toy adaptation, not a serious main route.
skip: useful historical port, but not the best modern official route.
skip: later console route, but less broadly preserved than the Orta/backward-compatible Xbox path.

all_releases.fidelity: Entire playable original included as bonus content in Panzer Dragoon Orta, with Orta later backward compatible on Xbox 360 and Xbox One.
all_releases.reason: primary: best modern official classic-version route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Saturn is the original hardware baseline; Orta's backward-compatible Xbox route is the most practical modern official way to play the classic release.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2020 remake is tracked separately and should not replace the classic Saturn/Orta-bonus entry.

entries.title: Panzer Dragoon II Zwei

emulation.notes: Use accurate Saturn emulation or original hardware.

primary.why: Zwei was released only for Sega Saturn, with no completed remake or modern release available yet. It remains a Saturn-first archival entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Saturn disc on original hardware or a high-accuracy Saturn emulator such as Mednafen/Saturn Beetle; revisit when the announced remake actually ships.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Saturn release with multiple paths, dragon growth, Pandora's Box extras, and subtitle-supported Panzer language.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only the Saturn release is currently playable as a completed sourced release.

entries.remaster_caveats: A remake is reported as in development, but no released platform/version is documented yet.

emulation.notes: Use Game Gear emulation or original hardware; no story content is present.

primary.why: Panzer Dragoon Mini is a Japan-only Game Gear spin-off with three playable dragons and no story. It has no alternate release route documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Game Gear cartridge on original hardware or a Game Gear emulator; treat it as a rare spin-off curiosity rather than a mainline substitute.

emulation.notes: Use original discs or legally sourced images with accurate Saturn emulation.

primary.why: Panzer Dragoon Saga was released only on Sega Saturn, has never been rereleased, and shipped in very small Western quantities. The original Saturn version is the only official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Saturn discs on hardware or an accurate Saturn emulator; expect high collector prices for legitimate English copies.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official release and never rereleased.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one official release exists; availability, not version choice, is the challenge.

entries.title: Panzer Dragoon Orta
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox release via backward compatibility

emulation.notes: Prefer official Xbox backward compatibility; use xemu only if compatibility is adequate.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Backward-compatible Xbox output or Xbox emulation

primary.version: Original Xbox release via backward compatibility
primary.why: Orta was released for Xbox and later made backward compatible on Xbox 360 and Xbox One, with the European 360 crash fixed by patch in 2018. It also includes unlockable series content, including the original Panzer Dragoon.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Xbox disc on Xbox One/Series backward compatibility where supported, or on original Xbox hardware; use xemu only after checking compatibility.

all_releases.reason: skip: original route, but later Xbox backward compatibility is the better modern route.

all_releases.fidelity: Backward-compatible route on later Xbox hardware, after Xbox 360 support and Xbox One compatibility; European 360 crash fixed in 2018.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Backward compatibility preserves the original while improving modern hardware access.

entries.title: Panzer Dragoon: Remake

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the PC remake.

primary.why: The 2020 remake updates the first game with modern graphics and an optional control scheme allowing independent aiming with the second stick. Windows is the highest-fidelity/configurable route among the documented remake platforms, but reviews note control/length caveats.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version for fidelity and configuration; use Switch/console versions only if their control setup suits your display and controller preference.

all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but not the highest-fidelity version.
skip: Stadia shutdown makes it a non-current route.

all_releases.fidelity: PC remake release with updated graphics and optional new aiming controls.

all_releases.reason: skip: solid console route, but PC is selected for fidelity/configuration.
skip: cloud route, not the archival primary.
skip: solid console route, but PC is selected for fidelity/configuration.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The remake modernizes graphics and controls but is a separate interpretation of the first game; the classic version remains tracked separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Reviews criticize controls/length; do not use the remake as a substitute for the classic archival route.
